question: For the selected densitized H spectral realization on the p-positive branch, does its exact spectral-coordinate map give a p-preserving unitary only to the support-restricted c target c<3p^2, and does the positive-measure complement obstruct an exact p-preserving unitary to the previously declared unrestricted M_c target?

upstream_results.role: fixes the selected p-positive KL spectral multiplier h(kappa,p)=3p^2-2*hbar^2*kappa^2 and its group-averaged zero-fiber measure
records the separate full-p selected-H completion while this calculation deliberately remains on its p-positive component to match the declared M_c representation
fixes the declared unrestricted p-positive M_c target L2(R_c times R_{+,p},dc dp), its maximal domain and its distributional c=0 form
fixes the separate local (P,p) to (c,p) principal FIO and retains its one-term exact-unitarity KILL
retains that the old endpoint data do not select a unique exact completion and that exact endpoint-transform existence remains open

primary_sources.source: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, sections 10.25 and 10.43
primary_sources.used_for: the already selected Fourier--Kontorovich--Lebedev spectral realization upstream
primary_sources.not_used_for: identifying the spectral-coordinate delta kernel with the old endpoint generator W

primary_sources.used_for: the direct-integral and zero-fiber framework boundary
primary_sources.not_used_for: proving a raw-C equivalence or selecting a physical inner product

primary_sources.used_for: the compact-interior graph-FIO interpretation of a delta kernel
primary_sources.not_used_for: a global FIO theorem at kappa=0 or an exact W endpoint-transform theorem

primary_sources.used_for: the boundary that global symbol, Maslov and domain data are additional to a compact-interior graph statement
primary_sources.not_used_for: repairing the frozen one-term Van Vleck nonunitarity

declared_model.source_space: X_plus=(0,infinity)_kappa times (0,infinity)_p with H_X=L2(X_plus,d kappa dp)
declared_model.selected_constraint: M_h with h(kappa,p)=3*p^2-2*hbar^2*kappa^2 and maximal domain h*A in L2
declared_model.restricted_target: Y_plus={(c,p):p>0,c<3*p^2} with H_less=L2(Y_plus,dc dp) and maximal M_c_less
declared_model.unrestricted_comparator: H_D=L2(R_c times (0,infinity)_p,dc dp) with declared maximal M_c
declared_model.component_boundary: p>0 throughout; this does not import the full-p completion or create a p=0 atom
declared_model.endpoint_boundary: the graph-FIO statement is restricted to compact interiors kappa>=kappa_min>0; no global assertion at kappa=0 or c=3*p^2
declared_model.old_fio_boundary: the exact spectral coordinates (kappa,p) are not the old endpoint momentum variables (P,p), so V is not the W(c,P,p) endpoint FIO

exact_plan: hash-verify all upstream result artifacts and verdicts
verify the inverse coordinate identities, positive Jacobian and change-of-variables relation on compactly supported interior tests
verify V and its inverse are exact isometries between the selected H spectral space and the restricted c target
verify strong intertwining of M_h, M_c_less and the companion multiplication observable p, including maximal-domain transport
verify that c=0 lies inside Y_plus and that the c=0 Lebesgue delta form pulls back to the selected H dp/(2*sqrt(6)*hbar*p) form
use an explicit positive-measure target witness in E={(c,p):p>0,c>=3*p^2} to prove the p-preserving joint-spectral obstruction for the unrestricted declared M_c target
record that the delta kernel is a compact-interior spectral graph FIO only and cannot repair the old W one-term exact-unitarity KILL
leave raw C, a W full symbol, endpoint-state transform, global edge gluing and all BFV/physical outputs null

decision_table.condition: the coordinate, Jacobian, unitary, operator-domain, zero-fiber and positive-measure complement checks pass under the stated compact-interior and p-preserving hypotheses
any coordinate, coarea, unitary, domain, zero-fiber or obstruction witness check fails
the calculation calls the restricted spectral target the declared unrestricted M_c representation, imports p<0, calls its delta kernel the W endpoint FIO, or asserts a global kappa=0 FIO completion

computed_scope: one p-positive selected-H spectral-coordinate unitary to a proper support-restricted c target
its selected-H operator and p multiplication intertwining and maximal-domain transport
one exact p-preserving joint-spectrum obstruction for the declared unrestricted M_c target
a compact-interior spectral graph-kernel/FIO interpretation only
not_computed: a raw-C spectral resolution, selected raw-C extension, raw-C/H equivalence, raw-C rigging map or physical inner product
an exact endpoint-state transform from (P,p) or (Q,phi), a W full symbol, or a repair of the one-term endpoint FIO KILL
a global FIO at kappa=0 or c=3*p^2, global Maslov gluing, an origin atom, p-negative identification or cross-branch gluing
a lapse contour, BFV measure, anomaly result, relational observable, semiclassical recovery, likelihood, quantum-gravity, physics or TOE claim
